defects.affected_capability: Test Management project/folder/test-case/test-run/test-plan discovery and execution routing
defects.consequence: An agent following the provider's own tool instructions can dead-end when a project identifier is unknown.
defects.route: Do not promote BrowserStack to VERIFIED. Recover project/build identifiers from provider-native config or another supported BrowserStack read path if available; otherwise use alternate verification providers until the connector exposes a valid resolver.
